english.title: Without authority prepare a report re suitability of a child for adoption / person to adopt child
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[being a person who was not within a prescribed description, in prescribed circumstances, prepared a report for]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person who was not within a prescribed description, in prescribed circumstances, to prepare a report for]_
(C)_[submitted a report which had been prepared by **(..SPECIFY PERSON WHO PREPARED REPORT..), a person who was not within a prescribed description, in prescribed circumstances, to]_

**(..SPECIFY RECEIVER OF REPORT..) about

(D)_[the suitability of a child for adoption]_
(E)_[the suitability of a person to adopt a child]_
(F)_[the adoption of a child]_
(G)_[the placement for adoption of a child]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 94 of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For definition of 'prescribed' see the Restriction on the Preparation Reports Regulations 2005 (SI 2005/1711)
(ii) If a person who works for an adoption society commits this offence, the person who manages the society is also guilty of the offence (s94(3)).

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
